claims.claim: AUTHOR_REPAIR reconstructs its TASK and failed subject from canonical FAILURE/RUN lineage, cross-checks Unified State, and includes regressions for unauthored, unrelated and split-brain planning.

AUTHOR_REMEDIATION reconstructs its TASK and finding subject from canonical RUN/RESULT/REVIEW lineage, requires the exact outstanding Unified State finding, and includes corresponding planning regressions.
Generic observe_brain_sync planning selection remains unchanged; the added BO-2/3 regression requires UNAUTHORED_TASK/TASK_AUTHORING despite canonical TASK-321 and TASK-322 documents.

Correction reconstruction checks canonical identities, TASK revision, candidate head, executor/base binding, repairability, transportability and Unified State before mutation; regressions cover malformed, stale, competing and mismatched lineage.
Correction packets project selected_task, immutable correction_subject identities and Unified State next_action into their freshness binding while projecting roadmap as null.
Audited handoff, Stage-1/Stage-2 validation, family validation and freshness/CAS rechecks remain mandatory for new correction mutations.

The moved-identity regression preserves the actual parent list, including an empty list, and asserts identical trees, distinct commit identities, changed packet fingerprints and prior-audit rejection for both correction operations.

The final commit is a fresh direct descendant of admitted r2 base 75a945cc4118f741d60a8fec3a98ea4231610fb4; RUN-322-001 and its candidate were inspected only as references and were not mutated or published.
All changes are confined to the eight permitted files; AUTHOR_TASK mutation code is unchanged, and no Planner, router, heuristic TASK discovery or new authority store was added.
